'''Reflections II: Expanding the Galaxy''' is the 28th Star Wars CCG product, published by Decipher on 10 January 2001. It is 154 cards (77 per side): 34 very rare foils, 62 super rare foils, 4 ultra rare foils, and 54 premium cards, plus five foil box/case toppers ([[Boba Fett With Blaster Rifle]], [[Han With Heavy Blaster Pistol]], [[Leia With Blaster Rifle]], [[Obi-Wan With Lightsaber]], and a Japanese [[Darth Vader]] case topper). CardGuide numbering: 28th product.

Packs are 18 cards, MSRP $4.95, 30 packs per box. Random reprint slots (generally Premiere, Jabba's Palace, Cloud City, Special Edition, and a Japanese card) are not listed. Some packs did not contain a Japanese card.<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2]</ref>

== Print sheets ==
Foils and premiums are 11&times;11 (121 cards). Light foil sheet: 3 box toppers 2&times;, 1 ultra rare, 15 very rare 3&times;, 34 super rare 2&times;, 1 blank. Dark foil sheet: 1 case topper 2&times;, 1 box topper 2&times;, 1 ultra rare, 19 very rare 3&times;, 28 super rare 2&times;, 1 blank. Premium sheet: 27 titles (15 four times and 12 five times) plus 1 blank.<ref name="encyc" />
